detections.name: Barnard's Star
detections.note: Barnard's Star: measured drift 11.94″/yr from these images (catalogue proper motion 10.39″/yr; the measured value also contains parallax and centroid error).

notes: Barnard's Star — fast-moving star: largest proper motion of any star: 10.4″ per year, almost due north.
The target is very bright: pixels of its core are flagged (overflow / saturation) in 8 of 8 frames, so its brightness values here are not reliable (hollow points in the charts).
Crosshair = position predicted for each date from the catalogue proper motion (10.4″/yr); predicted shift across these frames: 1.0 px (6.2″).
